{"metadata":{"description":"Two-level model circuit breaker with failover for DeepSeek Harness: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback","id":"gh:1334011962","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-model-failover","slug":"Letter2025/dsh-model-failover","topics":["circuit-breaker","dsh","dsh-plugin","failover"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Two-level model circuit breaker with failover for DeepSeek Harness: trip a model or a whole provider"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-model-failover"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Two-level model circuit breaker with failover for DeepSeek Harness. When a model (or a whole provide"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"r) starts failing repeatedly, the plugin opens a circuit and routes the next model request to a conf"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"igured fallback — no core changes, installable with `dsh plugin`."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Model circuit** — a `provider/model` route opens after `modelCircuitThreshold` failures inside `"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"burstWindowMs`.
- **Platform circuit** — a provider opens when `platformCircuitThreshold` distinct m"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"odels under it are open at once (a platform outage usually takes down every model on it).
- **Failov"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"er** — the next request goes to the first healthy fallback in `fallbacks`; the switch is recorded by"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" the loop itself (`request/header` change) and optionally announced as a user-visible message.
- **R"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ecovery probes** — an open model circuit is probed after `modelCooldownMs` with a tiny real call; a "},{"id":"p5s7","text":"successful probe closes the circuit, a failed one extends the cooldown.
- **Composes with `llm-retry"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"`** — per-request backoff retries stay owned by the bundled `llm-retry` policy; the breaker observes"},{"id":"p5s9","text":" the failures that escape it, so transient blips that recover after a retry never trip a circuit."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Then configure `fallbacks` (the only field you must set) and, if needed, the thresholds in your prof"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ile `cordis.patch.yml` — see the plugin row in cordis.patch.yml for the full default config."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"A companion skill, `configure-model-failover`, walks the agent through setting the fallback models ("},{"id":"p9s2","text":"AI probes the current model config, writes the fallback override, then asks you to confirm). It is *"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"*installed automatically with the plugin**: the package ships `skills/configure-model-failover/SKILL"},{"id":"p9s4","text":".md` and the plugin registers it as a bundled skill whenever the `skills` service is present — no co"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"py step needed. For a standalone install (profile without the plugin), copy it into `~/.dsh/skills/c"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"onfigure-model-failover/` (user-level skills are picked up live)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The plugin decorates two agent-loop waterfalls (both official extension points, no core changes):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Waterfall | Role |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `agent/request-error` | Records failures whose `code` is in `tripCodes` into the circuit breaker, "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"then delegates through `next()` so `llm-retry` still owns retries. |
| `agent/request` | `await next"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"()` for the resolved config, then returns the healthy primary route, or the first healthy fallback w"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"hen the primary's circuit is open. |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. |
| `fallbacks` | `[]` | Ordered fallback routes `{provider, m"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"odel}`; must point at providers with a registered adapter. |
| `tripCodes` | `RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TI"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"MEOUT, TRANSPORT, QUOTA, EMPTY_RESPONSE` | Failure codes that count toward a circuit; e.g. `AUTH`/`I"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"NVALID_CREDENTIAL` stay terminal. |
| `modelCircuitThreshold` | `2` | Failures inside the burst wind"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ow that open a model circuit. |
| `modelCooldownMs` | `60000` | Cooldown before an open model circui"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"t is probed. |
| `platformCircuitThreshold` | `2` | Distinct open models that open the whole provide"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"r. |
| `platformCooldownMs` | `120000` | Provider-wide cooldown. |
| `burstWindowMs` | `300000` | Fa"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ilures older than this start a fresh burst. |
| `enableProbe` | `true` | Probe open models after coo"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ldown to recover circuits. |
| `probeMaxTokens` | `8` | Output cap for probe calls. |
| `stripReason"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ingEffort` | `true` | Drop the primary's reasoning effort when failing over (fallbacks may not suppo"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"rt it). |
| `notifyUser` | `true` | Append a user-visible message when a route switches. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Events"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Plugin-defined (emit) events, typed via the `@deepseek-ai/cordis` augmentation in `src/types.ts`:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `model-failover/circuit-opened` — `{provider, model, level: 'model' | 'platform'}`
- `model-failov"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"er/circuit-closed` — `{provider, model, level: 'model'}`
- `model-failover/failover` — `{from, to, a"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"gentId}`
- `model-failover/probe` — `{provider, model, ok, message?}`"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Process-local state** — circuit state lives in memory and resets on plugin reload (like every ha"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"rness registry). Cross-instance sharing is deferred.
- **Agent-loop calls only** — `agent/request` c"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"overs the main conversation loop. Auxiliary calls (`session-title`, `compaction`, hand-built `ctx.ll"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"m.stream`) are not routed.
- **`retryPolicy.mode: 'always'`** — the bundled `llm-retry` never delega"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"tes a failure to this breaker in that mode, so failover stays idle by design (the operator chose unb"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ounded retries).
- **No context-window adaptation** — a fallback with a smaller context window may h"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"it `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`; set `stripReasoningEffort` and pick compatible fallbacks.
- **No platf"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"orm probe** — the platform circuit recovers by cooldown expiry; only model circuits are probed."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
